headline: How much longer do I wait for him to commit?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one prepared to decide.
Every tool is out, and both hands are ready.
You asked how much longer you wait for his commitment. The readiness for a decision holds my attention.
His commitment has not come, and you are still the one waiting for it.
The thing that has hold of the commitment keeps readiness from becoming an answer. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the commitment…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, yet you chose the one suspended by a single rope.
One rope circles one ankle. No other part is tied.
You asked for the remaining length of the wait. This card brings me to the one rope.
Still, the future is suspended while the waiting belongs to your life.
Something appears right where waiting would become a decision. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's sitting there…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing gave the picture away, but your hand went to the one at the beginning.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked how much longer you wait. The beginning on this card catches me.
But his answer has not come, and you are asking for a limit.
Something stands between the open road and his commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what is there…
